checks.title: 'hit rate ~ no-information baseline': is the conclusion robust to the null model?

declared.claim: 命中率与无信息基线同量级属预期（恰好说明流程无泄漏）

checks.detail: the quantitative clause ('same magnitude as chance') survives both null models (p=0.29 under U(0,1), p=0.58 under U(band); n=40, alpha=0.05 critical 11 hits, power 0.69 at p=0.30).  The inferential clause ('therefore no leakage') does not follow: not rejecting a null is not evidence for it, and a synthetic dry-run whose results derive from the same seeds cannot test leakage at all (report §⑤-5 says so itself).  Reported as an overstated inference, not as a numeric error
